title: 第576章 无路可逃第575章 我就知道
content_zh:
艾什给猎弓搭上箭矢，背靠树木不敢乱动，暗精灵们的箭矢又快又准，其中还混杂着弩矢飞过，相比较下来，艾什宁可胸口中箭矢也不想被弩矢击中。
三个人都躲在树后缩紧身子，以防被流矢射中，其实根本没有流矢，躲在北侧树林内的暗精灵压着大家射箭，只要身体稍稍露出树后一点，就能听到箭矢呼啸而过。
本打算遇到麻烦就撤退的三人，现在却没有任何地方可以离开，北边的树林里暗精灵的箭矢接连而出，南侧涌出的暗精灵更是冲杀高精灵城防卫队士兵，双方已经混战在了一起，没有撤出的可能了。
从箭矢飞过的声音，艾什就能听出那些箭矢的力道有多大，少许暗精灵射歪的箭矢擦过树干，甚至会带走一大片树皮，崩飞的木屑打在甲胄上声音怪骇人的。
艾什几次尝试歪头探身射箭，都被暗精灵的箭矢挡了回来，她有些焦急，这样下去，暗精灵们迟早会杀光其他人，最后包围三个倒霉蛋再杀掉。
情急之下，艾什又被一枚飞来的箭矢逼的一缩头，彻底躲在树后不敢动了，只能昂头高喊一边的卡森。
“卡森！盾牌！我在你后面跟着！我们的甲胄能挡住！没有甲胄的部位就看旧神庇佑了！”
同样缩着身子的卡森在混乱中听到了艾什的嗓音，他都不敢偏头，几次急促的呼吸后，扣上封闭盔的面盔，一转身举起盾牌边挡着箭矢边往艾什这边冲来。
暗精灵的箭矢打在卡森的鸢形盾上发出响亮的撞击声，艾什眼看着卡森的鸢形盾被多次打偏，持盾的手也在震颤，他弯腰交叉双腿，不得不边走边插回戍誓，被迫双手持盾以阻挡力道沉重的箭矢。
然而暗精灵们又不是蠢货，只对卡森的鸢形盾射箭，他们有意去瞄准卡森没有被鸢形盾护住的肢体，但他们很快发现，即使射箭到卡森的手臂和小腿上，他们的箭矢也没法射穿他的甲胄。
艾什看着卡森艰难走来，歪头对另一边狼狈抱头的泽瑞尔叫了一嗓子：“准备亮瞎他们的眼睛！泽瑞尔！”
也不管泽瑞尔有没有听见，艾什等卡森持盾来到树边立刻撑地爬起，旋转身体躲在卡森身后，左手用力拉弓弦扭转它，缩头偏身再眨眼，用自己的蛇瞳去看树林中灵魂的颜色。
黑暗的树林内，只有几个蓝色的灵魂在移动，艾什以它们为自己的目标，突然侧身离开卡森的盾牌后，松手射出箭矢。
猎弓的弓弦并不太紧，箭头也只是狩猎用的常见铁箭头，艾什深知它几乎没办法射穿甲胄，哪怕是皮甲或布甲，但只要能逼迫暗精灵们躲避和停止射箭就好。
一箭逼迫蓝色灵魂的暗精灵闪避躲开，艾什趁着随同卡森移动把箭袋挂在肩上，迅速抽出箭矢再次偏身对另一个暗精灵射箭，箭矢射出，对方顿了顿，但是看灵魂还是在移动，应该是没有射伤他。
持续射箭逼迫暗精灵们更换位置或躲藏，闪避，为卡森缓解了不少的压力，他也能更快来到泽瑞尔的树旁，伸手拽起泽瑞尔，泽瑞尔高声祈祷念动牧术祷词，主动挡在艾什前面，使得艾什在最后方射箭压制暗精灵。
卡森双手握稳鸢形盾，回头检查艾什两人有没有把身体都藏在他身后，便大踏步向北出击，于鸢形盾上方露出小半个头盔，透过观察缝去判断暗精灵的位置，可天色太暗他看不清箭矢射来的方向。
“艾什！你看得清楚吗？！他们都在哪？！”
“左前方五个，右前方三个，八个人！我只看到八个！我把他们分开！”
“左前方的五个人交给我和泽瑞尔，剩下三个是你的！泽瑞尔！牧术！”

“眯起眼睛让双眼适应！准备好了吗？！光耀术！”
泽瑞尔第一次在战斗时喊出了他的术式名称，艾什在他大喊前就先一步闭上眼，等感觉眼前一阵温暖外加光芒四射时，才缓缓睁眼使得眼睛不会因白金光芒而晃到。
虽然不知道光耀术能对艾什和卡森有什么帮助，不过艾什还是能明显感觉到自己的动作更快一些，三个人协同前进的速度比之前快得多，艾什抽拉箭矢射出的间隙也一样快。
白金的光芒把四周都照亮，暗精灵们一时被泽瑞尔身上的强光所晃眼，他们痛喊着去捂眼睛后退，卡森则趁机抽出戍誓，先一步冲向最近的暗精灵。
泽瑞尔掂量着页锤疯狂大笑，爆喝着祷词冲锋，艾什反应有些慢了，她先在肩上挂好猎弓，抽黑雀剑出来时弓弦卡住剑柄，艾什连续抽了三次才避开弓弦，提剑顿起速度，奔向右前方的三个暗精灵。
那三个暗精灵也被泽瑞尔的光耀术闪到眼睛，暗精灵在夜间看的比很多种族更清楚没错，卡森临时想到的计划反而针对了这些有着优势的家伙们。
他们跌跌撞撞地往后退，凭借双耳对声音的判断，向艾什突袭时的发出声音的大概方向勉强射箭，即使看不见，暗精灵射出的箭矢也颇准，可艾什和暗精灵一样，说不准比他们在夜里看的更清楚。
箭矢向艾什飞来，她侧劈黑雀剑，将其斩断或横过剑身弹开箭矢，她几步冲到最近的暗精灵身前，对方也听到了艾什接近的声音，满眼都是被闪出的泪水，下意识去拔腰间的短刀横切。
短刀的来回切割对艾什来说算不上威胁，她迅速观察暗精灵的穿着，对方穿着硬质的皮甲，这对艾什来说不算难题，平举黑雀剑在冲锋中一剑刺出，直接穿透暗精灵的皮甲钻进她的心脏。
女暗精灵的心脏被贯穿，黑雀剑穿透她背后的皮甲，顿时她全身失去了力气，又徒劳的挥舞了两下短刃，艾什抬起左脚踹在女暗精灵的小腹，把黑雀剑趁机抽出，又下劈黑雀剑砍在她的额头中间。
骨头碎裂的声音太熟悉不过了，艾什扭动剑柄甩腕使得女暗精灵别挡她的路，她跳过女暗精灵的尸体，奔袭下一个暗精灵。
content_en:
Ash loaded the arrows on his hunting bow, leaning against the trees and not daring to move around. The arrows of the dark elves were fast and accurate, and there were also crossbow bolts flying among them. In comparison, Ash would rather be hit by an arrow in the chest than be hit by a crossbow bolt.
The three of them hid behind the tree and tightened their bodies to prevent being hit by stray arrows. In fact, there were no stray arrows at all. The dark elves hiding in the woods on the north side pressed everyone to shoot arrows. As long as their bodies were slightly exposed behind the tree, they could hear the arrows whizzing by.
The three people who had planned to retreat when they encountered trouble now had nowhere to leave. The dark elves' arrows shot out one after another from the woods to the north, and the dark elves pouring out from the south rushed to kill the soldiers of the High Elf City Defense Force. The two sides were already engaged in a melee, and there was no possibility of withdrawal.
From the sound of arrows flying past, Ash could tell how powerful those arrows were. Some of the arrows shot crookedly by the dark elves grazed the tree trunks, and even took away a large piece of bark. The sound of flying sawdust hitting the armor was terrifying.
Ash tried several times to tilt her head and lean forward to shoot arrows, but was blocked by the arrows of the dark elves. She was a little anxious. If this continued, sooner or later the dark elves would kill everyone else, and finally surround the three unlucky ones and kill them.
In desperation, Ash was forced to shrink his head by another flying arrow. He completely hid behind the tree and did not dare to move. He could only raise his head and shout to Carson on the side.
"Carson! Shield! I'm following you! Our armor can block it! The parts without armor will depend on the blessing of the old gods!"
Carson, who was also shrinking, heard Ash's voice in the chaos. He didn't dare to turn his head. After a few rapid breaths, he buckled the visor of his closed helmet, turned around, raised his shield, and rushed toward Ash while blocking the arrows.
The dark elf's arrows hit Carson's kite-shaped shield with a loud impact. Ash watched Carson's kite-shaped shield being deflected many times, and the hand holding the shield was trembling. He bent over and crossed his legs, and had to insert his oath while walking, and was forced to hold the shield with both hands to block the heavy arrows.
However, the dark elves were not fools. They only fired arrows at Carson's kite-shaped shield. They deliberately aimed at Carson's limbs that were not protected by the kite-shaped shield. However, they soon discovered that even if they shot arrows at Carson's arms and calves, their arrows could not penetrate his armor.
Ash watched Carson walking hard, tilted his head and shouted to Zerrell who was holding his head in embarrassment on the other side: "Prepare to blind their eyes! Zerrell!"
Regardless of whether Zerrell heard it or not, Ash waited for Carson to reach the tree with his shield and immediately climbed up on the ground. He spun his body and hid behind Carson. He pulled the bow string with his left hand to twist it. He turned his head away and blinked again, using his snake eyes to see the color of the souls in the woods.
There were only a few blue souls moving in the dark woods. Ash used them as his targets. He suddenly turned away from Carson's shield, let go and shot an arrow.
The bowstring of the hunting bow was not too tight, and the arrowheads were just common iron arrowheads used for hunting. Ash knew that it could hardly penetrate armor, even leather or cloth armor, but as long as it could force the dark elves to dodge and stop shooting arrows, it would be fine.
An arrow forced the blue soul's dark elf to dodge. Ash took advantage of Carson's movement to hang the quiver on his shoulder. He quickly drew out the arrow and shot at the other dark elf again. When the arrow was shot, the opponent paused, but seeing that the soul was still moving, it probably didn't hurt him.
The continuous shooting of arrows forced the dark elves to change positions or hide or dodge, which relieved a lot of pressure for Carson. He was also able to reach Zerrell's tree faster, stretched out his hand to pull Zerrell up, and Zerrell prayed loudly and recited the pastoral prayer, actively blocking in front of Ash, allowing Ash to shoot arrows at the back to suppress the dark elves.
Carson held the kite-shaped shield steady with both hands, looked back to check whether Ash and the two had hidden their bodies behind him, and then strode northward, revealing a small half of his helmet above the kite-shaped shield. He used the observation slit to judge the position of the dark elves, but the sky was too dark and he could not see the arrows.direction of coming.
"Ash! Can you see clearly?! Where are they?!"
"Five on the left front, three on the right front, eight people! I only saw eight! I separated them!"
"The five people on the front left are given to me and Zerrell, and the remaining three are yours! Zerrell! Herding!"
"Squint your eyes and let your eyes adjust! Are you ready?! Radiant Technique!"
Zerrell shouted out the name of his technique for the first time during the battle. Ash closed his eyes before he shouted. When he felt a burst of warmth and radiance in front of his eyes, he slowly opened his eyes so that his eyes would not be dazzled by the platinum light.
Although he didn't know how the Radiance Technique could help Ash and Carson, Ash could clearly feel that his movements were faster. The three of them moved forward much faster than before, and the gap between Ash's arrows and arrows was just as fast.
The light of platinum illuminated the surroundings. The dark elves were momentarily dazzled by the strong light on Zerrell. They shouted in pain and covered their eyes and retreated. Carson took the opportunity to draw out his oath and rushed towards the nearest dark elf first.
Zerrell laughed wildly while weighing the hammer, shouting prayers and charging. Ash's reaction was a little slow. She hung the hunting bow on her shoulder first, and when she drew the black sparrow sword, the bowstring got stuck on the hilt. Ash drew three times in a row before avoiding the bowstring. She picked up the sword and rushed towards the three dark elves in front of her on the right.
The three dark elves were also dazzled by Zerrell's light spell. The dark elves could see more clearly at night than many races. Carson's impromptu plan instead targeted these guys with advantages.
They stumbled back, relying on their ears to judge the sound, and reluctantly shot arrows in the general direction of the sound when Ash attacked. Even if they couldn't see it, the arrows fired by the dark elves were quite accurate, but Ash, like the dark elves, might not be able to see more clearly than they could at night.
Arrows flew towards Ash. She slashed the black sparrow sword sideways, cutting it off or deflecting the arrows across the blade. She rushed to the nearest dark elf in a few steps. The other party also heard the sound of Ash approaching. Tears flashed across her eyes, and she subconsciously pulled out the short knife at her waist to cut across.
The back and forth cutting of the short knife was not a threat to Ash. She quickly observed the dark elf's clothing and found that the opponent was wearing hard leather armor. This was not a problem for Ash. She held the Black Sparrow Sword straight and stabbed out during the charge, directly penetrating the dark elf's leather armor and drilling into her heart.
The heart of the female Dark Elf was pierced, and the Black Sparrow Sword penetrated the leather armor on her back. She suddenly lost all strength, and swung the short blade twice in vain. Ash raised his left foot and kicked the female Dark Elf's abdomen, took the opportunity to withdraw the Black Sparrow Sword, and then slashed the Black Sparrow Sword down in the middle of her forehead.
The sound of broken bones was all too familiar. Ash twisted the hilt of the sword and flicked her wrist to make the female dark elf stay out of her way. She jumped over the female dark elf's body and ran towards the next dark elf.
